_doc: Intake questionnaire: EVERY input the assessment needs that the code cannot show. Guardrail: scan_repo.py, solutions.py, build_check.py, config_template.py, estimate_hours.py and build_doc.py refuse to run while a question that applies is unanswered. The agent asks each question in plain words with the multiple-choice tool and records ONLY what the user said; it never fills an answer in, and 'unknown' is accepted only when the user says it. stage: before_scan (asked right after discovery), after_scan (asked after scan_repo.py and map_infra.py, only when the scan found the thing the question is about: when_found), after_build (asked after the static build check). when: ask only if another answer has this value (a list means any of them; a multi answer matches when it contains the value). when_found: ask only if the scan, the build check or the third-party step produced one of these signals (rule ids; or the named signals build-blocked, inbound-public, licensed-components, rekey-integrations, scheduled-jobs). free_text: any text; 'unknown' is also accepted. affects: what the answer changes in the estimate or the document.

options.label: Build check + deployable artifacts
options.help: Make sure every solution builds on a clean agent, then produce the artifacts DevOps deploys on IIS / as Windows services.

options.label: CI/CD pipeline + Secrets Manager
options.help: Pipeline per solution, secrets and connection values moved into AWS Secrets Manager, DNS names instead of IPs. Also generates the tokenised config files and CI variable list.

options.label: Framework retarget
options.help: For example .NET Framework 4.7.2 or 4.8 to 4.8.1: a project-file change, a rebuild and a regression pass, no C# change.

options.label: Test-launch validation + cutover support
options.help: Check the application starts clean on the AWS instance, triage migration-side defects, support the cutover.
